title: DataProductEnvelope
description: The `(kind, schemaVersion, payload)` primitive every per-render data product is wrapped in on the daemon wire. Mirrors the `DataFetchResult` / `DataProductAttachment` Kotlin types (daemon/core/.../protocol/Messages.kt). Prose spec: docs/daemon/DATA-PRODUCTS.md (§ The primitive). `kind` and `schemaVersion` are always present; a producer carries exactly one primary transport — inline `payload`, a sibling-file `path`, or base64 `bytes`.

x-composeai.note: The payload shape is per-kind; see the kind's own schema. This envelope only constrains the wrapper. (The looser `{kind, payload}` shape in the VS Code preview-harness fixtures is the webview's internal form, not this wire envelope.)

schemaVersion.description: Positive integer owned by the kind. Bumped only on incompatible payload changes; additive fields do not bump.

payload.description: Inline JSON; shape per-kind. Use for anything under ~64 KB serialised.

path.description: Absolute path to a sibling file the renderer wrote; lifecycle matches the PNG.

bytes.description: base64; only when the caller passed `inline: true`.

extras.description: Optional non-JSON side outputs (derived images, etc.); pointer-only. See DataProductExtra in Messages.kt.
